lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\OpenOTPAuth\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
2 classes in lib/ whose name does not follow PSR-4 below OCA\OpenOTPAuth, the namespace the server derives from <namespace> of info.xml. The loader of the server does not find such a class.
vendor/ ships 16 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 32. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

lines: 1 route names a controller class or a method that does not exist, or a method that is not public. A request to such a route ends in an error.
GET /index.php/apps/openotp_auth/  openotp_auth.page.index  appinfo/routes.php:30 routes: no class OCA\OpenOTPAuth\Controller\PageController

Nothing in the app calls 1 route outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 17 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
The frontend or a template builds 4 URLs below /apps/openotp_auth/ that no route of the app matches. The request fails at run time.

psalm/phar, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

14 inline styles in templates/. The default Content Security Policy of the server allows inline style; a response whose policy disallows it drops them. A stylesheet added with OCP\Util::addStyle() holds in both cases.
lib/ reads the clock directly in 1 place. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 45 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
